description: Speech-to-text with word timestamps for a local video/audio file, with a local Whisper model. Needs the add-on `captionseasy-transcribe` (returns ADDON_MISSING with the install command if absent); its first call downloads the model once (~200 MB). Returns { language, durationMs, words: [{ text, startMs, endMs }] }. language: "en" (default), "hinglish" or "auto". Pass `out` to also save the words as JSON.

video.description: Absolute path of the local video or audio file

name: transcribe
title: Transcribe a video
